QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Campaigner (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: Stew gave you a reward and a Contributor Badge. Find out what it's for.
QuestInfo.1: You can get powerful badges if you collect Contributor Badges.
QuestInfo.2: Proudly put on your Campaigner Badge and continue your adventures!

0.0: Hey, a Contributor Badge! I thought my nephew stole all of those. Could you get some more for us?

yes.0: Thanks, little blue-blood! I'll buy you some cookies next time I see you!

1.0: Did you get more badges? Are you feeling extra contributy now?

item.0: I think you could use a few more.
